fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology has a plan to put USD 450 million to 860 million a year from the state budget into data centres and cloud infrastructure, according to the second edition of the National AI Strategy, a copy of which القاهرة 24 obtained.
title: بين 450 و860 مليون دولار.. الاتصالات تضع خطة محكمة لـ الاستراتيجية الوطنية للذكاء الاصطناعي
